scope: Three complete screened analytic Hessian columns (66 Cartesian entries), component and selected reciprocal checks. No full screened matrix or public route.
retained_failed_attempts: One PM process aborted during OpenMP initialization with a duplicate-runtime diagnostic. A fresh process with the same one-thread environment passed. No duplicate-runtime override used; no numerical threshold changed.
limitations: No complete screened matrix has been assembled or checked here. Selected reciprocal entries are not full-matrix symmetry.
Column rotation checks use the nonstationary gradient term; no rigid-motion projection or symmetrization is applied by the assembler.
LiH has three diagonal retained pairs and no triples; no screened frozen-core off-diagonal/triples validation.
H2 retained triplets have repeated occupied indices and equal rank-eight TNO spaces. Broader distinct-index/unequal-rank molecular coverage remains.
Provider requires zero AO Schwarz and occupied Fock screens; dense AO derivative input delivery is not a scaling implementation.
Prior raw PNO second-value precision limitations remain documented; independent references here difference native analytic gradients.
